name: Standard Spring Parts
old_description: Standard Spring has been in the leaf spring business since 1923. And as a distributor of high quality leaf springs and truck suspension parts to those who perform the installation, our focus is on others’ success in doing the job right. Standard does not work on the truck directly, but is here to serve and support those who do.
about:
Standard Spring Parts operates from Arden Hills, Minnesota, tracing its roots to 1923 when Percy Emory incorporated Standard Spring Co. in St. Paul. The company began as a blacksmith shop forging leaf springs with fire, hammers, and anvils. In 1944, blacksmith Hilding Ostrom purchased the business, establishing a family lineage that continues today under third‑generation owner Scott Ostrom, his wife Joy, and their son Garrett.

The firm no longer manufactures springs; since 2010 it has functioned as a distributor and warehouse for new leaf‑spring assemblies and related suspension hardware. Its catalog covers custom‑bent U‑bolts, trunnion stands, spring pins, insulator pads, and bolster springs for brands such as Mack, Freightliner, Peterbilt, Hendrickson, and Fruehauf. The operation stocks thousands of part numbers from a single warehouse, serving installers and repair shops rather than working on vehicles directly.

Customers include heavy‑duty truck repair facilities, fleet maintenance departments, and trailer builders that service Class 7‑8 trucks, buses, and trailers. The product range addresses front and rear suspensions for Mack Camelback, Freightliner TufTrac, Peterbilt Low Mount Air Leaf, and Hendrickson Haulmaax systems, among others.

The Ostrom family emphasizes that their role is to support the technicians who install the parts, not to compete with them. This installer‑first philosophy, combined with nearly a century of application knowledge, is presented as the company’s distinguishing advantage.
